summary: The system that manages panels made of multiple linked pages, like the app menu's forward/back subviews.
description: PanelMultiView and PanelView are plain ES classes (not custom elements) that attach behavior to <panelmultiview> and <panelview> XUL elements via a WeakMap-backed lazy association (AssociatedToNode.forNode). PanelMultiView manages a XUL <panel>'s open/close lifecycle and slide transitions between a main view and stacked subviews; PanelView wraps a single <panelview> and its header/sizing state.

attributes.name: mainViewId
attributes.description: Attribute on <panelmultiview>; id of the <panelview> shown as the main view when the panel opens.

attributes.name: viewCacheId
attributes.description: Attribute on <panelmultiview>; id of an element that subviews are moved into (via _moveOutKids()) before the panel is removed, so they survive removePopup().

attributes.name: disablekeynav
attributes.description: Attribute on <panelmultiview>; when present, arrow-key/Tab view navigation (the capturing keydown listener added on popupshowing) is not registered.

attributes.name: lockpanelvertical
attributes.description: Attribute read from the first open view's node (openViews[0].node); when "true", a subview's height is locked to the previous view's height instead of resizing to fit.

attributes.name: mainview
attributes.description: Set on a <panelview>'s node by the mainview setter, true while that view is being shown as the panel's main view (vs. a pushed subview).

attributes.name: no-back-button
attributes.description: Attribute on a <panelview>; suppresses the automatic back button that headerText would otherwise prepend.

attributes.name: has-custom-header
attributes.description: Attribute on a <panelview>; keeps a custom header element from being removed when headerText is cleared.

attributes.name: mainview-with-header
attributes.description: Attribute on a <panelview>; same effect as has-custom-header, keeps the header even with no title.

events.name: ViewShowing
events.description: Dispatched (async, cancelable via addBlocker on the detail) on a <panelview> when it is about to be opened as the main view or a subview; handlers can populate the view or cancel showing it.

events.name: ViewShown
events.description: Dispatched on a <panelview> once it becomes the active, visible view.

events.name: ViewHiding
events.description: Dispatched on a <panelview> when it is closed (navigated away from or the panel is closing).

events.name: PanelMultiViewHidden
events.description: Dispatched on the <panelmultiview> node after the underlying panel's popuphidden handling and view teardown complete.

methods.name: PanelMultiView.openPopup
methods.description: static(panelNode, ...args): opens the <panel> containing a <panelmultiview>, showing its mainViewId view; if the panel has no <panelmultiview>, opens the panel directly.

methods.name: PanelMultiView.hidePopup
methods.description: static(panelNode, animate): closes the <panel>, or the <panelmultiview> instance's hidePopup if present.

methods.name: PanelMultiView.removePopup
methods.description: static(panelNode): moves any child subviews to the view cache (if configured) and removes the panel from the document.

methods.name: PanelMultiView.getViewNode
methods.description: static(doc, id): returns the DOM node for a view id, falling back to the appMenu-viewCache template content.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Instance: builds the viewcontainer/viewstack elements and wires popupshowing/popupshown/popuphidden listeners.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Instance: removes event listeners set up by connect().

methods.name: openPopup
methods.description: Instance: openPopup(anchor, options, ...args), async; shows the main view then calls the panel's native openPopup.

methods.name: hidePopup
methods.description: Instance: hidePopup(animate); closes the panel and synchronously closes all open views.

methods.name: showSubView
methods.description: Instance: showSubView(viewIdOrNode, anchor); slides in a subview.

methods.name: goBack
methods.description: Instance: navigates back to the previous view in the stack.

methods.name: closeAllViews
methods.description: Instance: raises ViewHiding for every open view, in reverse order.

methods.name: PanelView.isOpenIn
methods.description: Instance (PanelView): isOpenIn(panelMultiView); whether this view is the one currently open in the given PanelMultiView.

methods.name: PanelView.headerText
methods.description: Instance (PanelView) setter; adds, updates, or removes the view's .panel-header (with back button and separator) based on the given title.
